text: Understanding Mutual Funds for Beginners. What is a Mutual Fund?
A mutual fund pools money from many investors and invests it in equities, bonds, or money market instruments according to the fund's objective.
Professional fund managers oversee the portfolio and make investment decisions based on thorough market research and SEBI risk guidelines.
Investors can start with small amounts through Systematic Investment Plans (SIP) starting from as low as 500 rupees per month.
Mutual fund investments are subject to market risks. Read all scheme related documents carefully before investing. There are no guaranteed returns in mutual funds.
Always check the Scheme Information Document (SID) and Key Information Memorandum (KIM) before investing your hard-earned money.
